transcript.answer: No, not as it works now. Pull request #3376 (merged 2026-10-23) removed the `auto-merge-fix` agent and its `fix-pr` and `fix-replies` stations. `auto-merge.yaml` is now `await-merge → approve → done`. `decideMergeReady` answers only ready or wait, so a red, conflicted or thread-blocked pull request is waited out and not fixed. Auto merge only waits and approves. Keeping a pull request mergeable is now the job of the implementation loop that opened it. Its `await-pr` check and a `loop-pr-upkeep` upkeep run handle behind, conflicted or red pull requests. Before #3376, #3320 had given the auto-merge loop an `auto-merge-fix` agent that did fix red CI, conflicts and open review threads, up to three rounds.
